dispositions.reason: Masked by BootGate on a cold load, as recorded for the before state; the branch stays covered by the mounted component test.
Masked by BootGate on a cold load, as recorded for the before state; the branch stays covered by the mounted component test.
BootGate follows the same shared query keys and withholds the route tree while they are pending; the native surface is Boot, pictured by the boot case.
Masked by BootGate on a cold load, as recorded for the before state; the branch stays covered by the mounted component test.
The client emits its first stages synchronously before its first await; the stage-null branch is not a stable native hold.
Success hands off to Review, whose after evidence belongs to the workout-lifecycle group; this deterministic lane asserts no provider success.
Auth restoration is shown by Boot checking before the public guards; Welcome’s actions are never flashed.

observations.text: After the typed refusal no profile was onboarded, and Back shows the note, limitation, goal and section exactly as chosen.
All three held generation POSTs carried the same request keys, the chosen anchor, the 30-minute duration and the typed notes, each with an x-request-id.
Anonymous boot reached Welcome with zero /rest/v1 initialization reads.
Boot progress is discrete segments, each lit or not.
Focus stays Generate’s for this workout only: the override lives in the URL and "Use the recommended focus" returns to the history recommendation.
Intensity: label and readout above the track; the installed thumb rule is a 16px square with radius 0.
Onboarding step 1 of 5 lights 4 of 20 discrete progress segments.
Retry reran the failed profile read once and reached the requested protected route; the reads that had succeeded were kept.
Successful new-user verification landed on /onboarding (existing guard), not Home.
Successful returning-user verification landed on Home (/) and reached Generate with the same session.
Time available carries a non-editable, non-selectable "min" unit inside its frame, tied to the input by aria-describedby.

Before this task Time available stated its unit as helper text ("Minutes.") below the field; the route now passes the package unit prop instead, so the unit sits in the frame as the 0.14.3 Input specimen shows.

No field on the owned routes is disabled or read-only in a reachable state: disabled is carried by buttons and chips (pictured), and the package Input disabled/read-only frame remains covered by the focused component tests.

The owned routes render no native RadioButton: every single choice is a ChoiceGroup of Chips with radio semantics. The solid-square mark is therefore proved on the real Checkbox, whose .clr-check__box rule the package RadioButton shares.
A namespaced real new user verified through the public endpoint; the first onboarding commit is held then answered 500, the retry is the genuine RPC.
A namespaced real new user; the impossible Minimal + Carries proposal is refused by the genuine onboarding RPC.
OTP delivery is held and answered locally; verify negatives are typed boundary answers. No sample auth screen is involved.
Only the real session user’s profile GET is held then failed; Retry reads the actual profile. Every other initialization read is genuine.
Scoped reads for the real session user only: profile with goal_preset null; an empty locations list; three parsed history rows; six anchor_evidence rows.
The generate-workout POST is held and answered locally with typed failures; nothing is forwarded to a provider, so this is not generation proof.
A focused Anchor chip is framed by the static bracket layer; Enter/Space toggle it as a pressed button.
Arrow keys step the focused Intensity slider and return it.
Retry is reachable by keyboard on the failed boot and is the only action offered.
Return to CLEAR is followed with Enter from the unmatched route and lands a signed-in user on Home.
Space toggles a focused section checkbox; the checked state is a solid 10px square, the unchecked state has no mark.
Tab from Sign in on Welcome moves to the next action; the root bracket layer follows it.
The Email field owns its focus: its frame lights and the bracket layer stays hidden.
The deload confirmation holds focus inside the native dialog and Escape dismisses it without raising intensity.
The setup radiogroup is one tab stop; ArrowRight moves focus and selection, and the static bracket layer frames the focused chip.
Under prefers-reduced-motion an authenticated boot hands off to the requested route with nothing left animating.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the anonymous boot hands off to Welcome with no running animation or transition.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the held loading screen keeps its status text and runs no animation.
